Marta (CS): heads up — OmniRetail opened a support escalation: after last night's reranker push, identical payloads are returning different score orders. customer says their client code is unchanged.
Eli (SRE): do we have request ids or timestamps to reproduce?
Marta (CS): grabbed two samples from their logs, sent ~4m apart. req ids: r_9a1b2c (2024-11-06T22:08:41Z), r_9a1b7f (2024-11-07T02:12:07Z). payload sanitized below.
Marta (CS): payload:
```json
{
  "route": "rerank",
  "model": "reranker-prod",
  "query": "best lightweight running shoes for trail",
  "candidates": ["A","B","C"],
  "top_k": 3
}
```
Marta (CS): response (older):
```json
{"scores": [0.71, 0.53, 0.29]}
```
Marta (CS): response (post-deploy):
```json
{"scores": [0.52, 0.64, 0.30]}
```
Marta (CS): UX shows reordering; customer flagged relevance regressions for a subset of queries.
Nina (ML): do we have model_id / artifact tags attached? Any tokenizer or preprocessing changes between versions?
Marta (CS): their logs tag the responses as reranker-prod@2024-11-06-22 (older) and reranker-prod@2024-11-07-02 (new).
Jordan (Infra): deploy-bot: "deploy: reranker-prod v2024-11-07T01:50 -> prod". I'll fetch the model manifests and diff tokenizer fields.
Jordan (Infra): quick manifest diff: old tokenizer.normalizer=\"NFC\"; new tokenizer.normalizer=\"NFKC\". also a new flag tokenizer.token_merging=true in the v2 artifact.
Nina (ML): that would change token boundaries for certain punctuation/ligature cases and whitespace handling. even if candidates look identical, internal token sequences can differ and affect scoring. plausible root cause.
Eli (SRE): Omni didn't report any 4xx/5xx or malformed warnings, just score divergence, correct?
Marta (CS): correct — no errors, just ordering variance. attaching their sample logs to the ticket.
Nina (ML): repro plan: 1) pull both tokenizers from model bucket, 2) tokenize query+candidates and diff token sequences, 3) run deterministic reranker on both tokenizations locally to check logits and rank swaps.
Marta (CS): customer wants a fast mitigation path. what's shortest safe move?
Jordan (Infra): short-term: pin the customer's routing to the pre-deploy model artifact (tokenizer parity). I can apply a per-account route override and set a 24h expiry while we investigate.
Jordan (Infra): applied route override for acct:omniretail -> reranker-prod@old (route-override-0456). expires 2024-11-08T02:05:00Z.
Marta (CS): customer confirmed ordering reverted after pin. they asked for ETA and root cause writeup.
Nina (ML): long-term mitigation proposals: 
- enforce tokenizer checksum in model manifest; require explicit release notes if normalization/merging changes.
- CI preflight: run seeded rerank regression harness (10k pairs) comparing old->new artifacts; block auto-promote on >0.5% top-1 swaps for customer-impacting routes.
- post-deploy smoke: small golden-query battery triggered by deploy webhook; alert on >threshold top-N changes.
Eli (SRE): I'll wire the smoke test into the post-deploy pipeline and create alert rules. also suggest a quick telemetry dashboard showing per-route top-1 drift after each model rollout.
Jordan (Infra): created infra ticket INF-24-7789, assigned to @Nina and @Eli for triage and remediation steps.
deploy-bot: route override applied for account omniretail (route-override-0456), expires 2024-11-08T02:05:00Z.
Marta (CS): noted. customer PM wants to be on preview for the fix; added their contact to the ticket.
Nina (ML): initial tokenizer diff notes: NFC->NFKC impacts ligatures and some punctuation normalization; token_merging can collapse adjacent tokens in some vocab mappings. effect is largest for short, punctuation-rich queries but can also shift scores for natural-language queries with punctuation. I'll post exact token sequence diffs and a deterministic log dump EOD.
Nina (ML): repro snippet (python) for team:
```python
from rerank_tokenizer import Tokenizer
q = "best lightweight running shoes for trail"
cands = ["A","B","C"]
for tag in ["old","new"]:
    t = Tokenizer.load(f"/models/reranker/{tag}/tokenizer.json")
    print(tag, t.tokenize(q), [t.tokenize(c) for c in cands])
```
Nina (ML): harness uploaded: s3://ci-rerank/omniretail_regression/seedset.tar.gz
Eli (SRE): once Nina posts diffs, I'll add the golden queries to the smoke job and tune alert thresholds.
Marta (CS): keeping this open until fix is promoted & Omni validates. customer appreciated the quick pin. I'll send a summary to their PM and update the ticket with Nina's findings.
Eli (SRE): moving to monitoring + follow-up.
Marta (CS): closing the escalation after verification steps are complete.
